payload.reason: The evidence provides specific details about the neural network modules included in NeuronBlocks, particularly from the Block Zoo.

claims.text: NeuronBlocks includes various neural network modules such as embedding layers, RNN, CNN, QRNN, Transformer, Highway networks, and Encoder-Decoder architectures.
Attention mechanisms supported in NeuronBlocks include Linear/Bi-linear Attention, Full Attention, and Bidirectional attention flow.
Regularization layers like Dropout, Layer Norm, and Batch Norm are also part of the toolkit.
NeuronBlocks provides loss functions beyond those in PyTorch, including Focal Loss.
